**Verified by source inspection at `fe8c644e`:** Keeping `1790042972.sh` avoids rerunning the migration on machines that already completed that file. The [earlier review’s](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/pull/12871#issuecomment-5776298648) rerun summary described `d19baaa`, not this revised head; its positive framing is superseded, not a reason to restore the rename.

| Existing completion marker | Current migration pending? |
| --- | --- |
| Only `1789581661.sh` | Yes |
| `1790042972.sh`, alone or with the older marker | No |

This preserves subsequent package removal or bar customization on already-completed machines. When pending, the migration retains **install → rescan → placement request**, with no new user-plugin link. Package failure stops the sequence; an absent shell retains the existing best-effort behavior. Existing links are left untouched.

## Remaining dev-linked dependency: the updated scanner must be running

The [author’s deployment caveat](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/pull/12871#issuecomment-5789369089) still applies when the migration is pending, no working user link exposes Elsewhen, and no existing bar entry or relative clone satisfies `put`:

```text
Old dev-linked scanner remains running
  → packaged Elsewhen is outside its scan roots
  → put returns unknown
  → migration fails before the update's final shell restart
```

**Impact:** Updating the files for #12872 in the same update does not itself replace that running scanner. Release installs use the packaged plugin directory and do not have this discovery gap.

**Suggested change:** Make the deployment prerequisite explicit: dev-linked shells need the #12872 discovery implementation running before this simplified migration executes. Merge order alone does not establish that runtime state. No additional defect was confirmed in this migration change.
